note: Road km and drive minutes from points on a regular grid (0.18° x 0.09°, about 10 km) to the radiotherapy unit of the municipality each point lies in (the unit routes.json uses). OSRM snaps each point to the nearest road; the off-road part is not counted. Used only to draw the burden terrain; every number in the cards and totals still comes from municipality centre points. 101 points whose route was implausibly long for their municipality (snapped to roads in Russia or long ferry waits) were dropped, and points without a route were filled with the mean of their routed neighbours.
